caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects against a plain, light beige background. The object in the upper right section consists of a pair of metal scissors with looped finger holes and a pivot joint, shown in an open position. The scissors are grey with some shading to indicate metallic texture and slight wear. In the lower left portion, there is a compact, spring-loaded metal snipping tool, shaped with an oval opening at the top and short, triangular blades visible inside. Both tools have visible screws and mechanical joints, with engraved markings on their surfaces. The metal surfaces are depicted with varying shades of grey, and the overall composition features these objects spaced apart with significant empty space around them. The name "WELLINGTON BLEWETT" is printed in uppercase letters near the lower right part of the drawing.
title: Scissors
